vBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2312: transient better-sqlite3 prebuilt-binary fetch hard-fails fresh workspace init (no Python for node-gyp fallback on Alpine)

plan.title: Make the better-sqlite3 rebuild non-fatal in workspace init
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: infra/.devcontainer-template/docker-compose.devcontainer.yml.template:42 runs `npm rebuild better-sqlite3 2>&1 &&`. The bare `&&` makes the rebuild fatal: on the Alpine init image (no python3/make/g++), any transient prebuild-install fetch failure falls back to a node-gyp source build that dies for lack of Python, so the whole init service exits non-zero. Because frontend/server depend_on init with condition service_completed_successfully, the workspace stack goes unhealthy and `pan start` aborts — requiring a manual `pan workspace rebuild`. This is disproportionate: better-sqlite3 is a dev-only transitive dependency (via the evalite devDependency; absent from src/ and from direct package.json deps). The dashboard runtime uses bundled node:sqlite/bun:sqlite and never needs better-sqlite3, yet a flaky fetch of it hard-fails all fresh-workspace creation and threatens the stability-drain.
narratives.Proposal: Adopt issue option 1 (preferred, smallest): make the rebuild non-fatal by wrapping it in a subshell that warns and continues on failure, reusing the exact `{ cmd || { fallback; }; } &&` idiom already used by the `bun install` line (line 40) in the same file. Change line 42 to `{ npm rebuild better-sqlite3 2>&1 || echo 'WARN: ... continuing init (PAN-2312).'; } &&`. All later init steps (contracts build, dashboard server build, UNRESOLVED_IMPORT guard) stay fatal and unchanged. The committed fix is the template (source of truth); the gitignored rendered per-workspace compose is mirrored locally but not part of the diff. Add a unit test that reads the real template, parses the init command, and asserts the rebuild is non-fatal.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT add python3/make/g++ to the init image (option 3).
- Do NOT exclude or filter better-sqlite3 from bun install (option 4).
- Do NOT add a retry loop around the rebuild (option 2) — non-fatal makes it unnecessary.
- Do NOT weaken the fatality of any other init step (contracts build, dashboard server build, the UNRESOLVED_IMPORT guard at line 47 all remain fatal).
- Do NOT commit or force-add the gitignored rendered .devcontainer/docker-compose.devcontainer.yml.

autoDecisions.summary: Chose issue option 1 (make rebuild non-fatal) over options 2/3/4.
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue names option 1 as preferred and smallest; runtime never uses better-sqlite3, so once its failure is non-fatal a retry (2) adds complexity for a harmless failure, and image/install changes (3/4) are larger surface for no runtime benefit. Simplicity-first.

autoDecisions.summary: Committed fix targets the template only; rendered compose mirrored locally but not diffed.
autoDecisions.rationale: git check-ignore confirms <workspace>/.devcontainer/docker-compose.devcontainer.yml is gitignored and regenerated from the template, so only the template edit reaches main and future workspaces.

autoDecisions.summary: Warn on failure rather than silently swallow.
autoDecisions.rationale: A stdout warning naming better-sqlite3 as a dev-only dep keeps init logs diagnosable while still not aborting.

items.title: Wrap the better-sqlite3 rebuild in the init template so a failure warns and continues

expected_outputs: grep matches the non-fatal wrapper (`npm rebuild better-sqlite3 2>&1 ||`) on the init command line
git status shows the template file modified

narrative.Action: In infra/.devcontainer-template/docker-compose.devcontainer.yml.template, change the init service command line 42 from `npm rebuild better-sqlite3 2>&1 &&` to a non-fatal subshell: `{ npm rebuild better-sqlite3 2>&1 || echo 'WARN: better-sqlite3 rebuild failed (dev-only transitive dep via evalite; runtime uses bundled node:sqlite/bun:sqlite) — continuing init (PAN-2312).'; } &&`. Reuse the exact `{ ... || { ...; }; } &&` idiom already on line 40 (bun install). Leave every other step in the folded-block command unchanged and fatal (contracts build, dashboard server build, and the UNRESOLVED_IMPORT guard at line 47). Mirror the identical edit into this workspace's local rendered .devcontainer/docker-compose.devcontainer.yml (line 42) so the workspace rebuilds cleanly — but do NOT force-add it; it is gitignored and will not appear in the PR diff.

items.title: Given the init template, when npm rebuild better-sqlite3 exits non-zero, then the init command continues (subshell `|| echo` wrapper) instead of aborting on a bare `&&`.
The wrapper emits a stdout warning naming better-sqlite3 as a dev-only transitive dep when the rebuild fails.
The diff preserves the later init steps (contracts build, dashboard server build, UNRESOLVED_IMPORT guard) unchanged, and each still exits init non-zero on failure.
The rendered template produces valid YAML that yields a non-empty services.init.command string when parsed.
Add a unit test asserting the init template tolerates the better-sqlite3 rebuild failing

expected_outputs: the new test file passes (all assertions green)

narrative.Action: Create tests/unit/lib/workspace/devcontainer-init-command.test.ts. Following the precedent at tests/unit/dashboard/config.test.ts:85, read the real template with readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), 'infra/.devcontainer-template/docker-compose.devcontainer.yml.template')), replace `{{PLACEHOLDER}}` tokens, parse with `import { parse as parseYaml } from 'yaml'` (the exact import config.test.ts uses), and extract services.init.command. Assert: (1) the command contains the non-fatal wrapper `npm rebuild better-sqlite3 2>&1 ||`; (2) the command does NOT contain the bare fatal form `npm rebuild better-sqlite3 2>&1 &&` (which would abort init on rebuild failure); (3) services.init.command is a non-empty string that still parses. No timers/network — pure string+YAML assertions, so no fake-timer scaffolding is needed.

items.title: The test reads the real infra template, parses the init service command, and asserts it contains the non-fatal `npm rebuild better-sqlite3 2>&1 ||` wrapper.
The test rejects the pre-fix form: it asserts services.init.command does NOT contain the bare `npm rebuild better-sqlite3 2>&1 &&` that would abort init on rebuild failure.
`npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/workspace/devcontainer-init-command.test.ts` exits 0 with all assertions passing against the fixed template.
